residual_risks: The document-key migration is forward-only inside disposable desktop-native cache. Returning to a helper that expects the legacy document shape may require retiring that derived cache with all helper processes stopped; authoritative session logs remain untouched and official fallback remains available.

reviewed: native-helper/src/index.rs opens only desktop-text-v1.sqlite under the independently owned cache directory; runtime.mjs selects DSH_HOME/cache/desktop-native.

Legacy rows map session, seq, text and folded unchanged, with part=0 and preview=NULL. BEGIN IMMEDIATE covers rename, copy, drop, default-backed quota columns, backfill and LRU index creation; migration errors roll back.
Cache eviction and suffix replacement commit atomically with revision comparison. Search revision validation and result selection share one SQLite snapshot, including empty results.
Existing migration, quota, disk-full and two-helper tests were inspected; previously reported passing tests were not rerun.
verification_queries: SELECT d.session FROM documents d LEFT JOIN sessions s USING(session) WHERE s.session IS NULL LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.session FROM sessions s WHERE s.documents <> (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seq) FROM documents d WHERE d.session=s.session) LIMIT 1;
SELECT session,seq FROM documents GROUP BY session,seq HAVING MIN(part)<>0 OR MAX(part)+1<>COUNT(*) LIMIT 1;
deployment_notes.query_caveat: Run optional integrity queries only against the derived cache; quick_check should return ok and invariant queries should return no rows. Do not mutate or migrate official logs or official index databases.
